title: Reinstatement Deposit Scale by Financial Assistance Award
content:
Financial-assistance coordination standard — **Patient Payment Plans**: the reinstatement deposit on a defaulted plan, scaled by the patient's award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program.

## The rule

The reinstatement deposit is set by the patient's financial-assistance award: none for an approved award whose discount percentage is 50 percent or more, one quarter of the regular installment for an approved award whose discount percentage is at least 25 percent and below 50 percent, and one full regular installment for any other patient.

The deposit is the regular installment standing on the plan multiplied by the share below, taken to the nearest cent, an exact half cent being rounded up, and it forms part of the reinstatement payment.

| Approved award's discount percentage | Reinstatement deposit |
|---|---|
| 50 or more | None (0) |
| At least 25 and below 50 | One quarter of the regular installment (25 percent) |
| Below 25, or no approved award | One full regular installment (a share of 1) |

**Approved award** means a case of the patient under the Patient Financial Assistance Program whose status is approved; the discount percentage is that of the award on the case. A case under review or denied is not an approved award.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical patients; regular installment 130.00)

| Patient's award | Deposit |
|---|---|
| Approved, 75 percent | 0.00 |
| Approved, exactly 50 percent | 0.00 — 50 is "50 or more" |
| Approved, 25 percent | 32.50 — 25 is "at least 25" |
| Approved, below 25 percent | 130.00 |
| Application under review | 130.00 |
| No assistance case | 130.00 |
